item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 5 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 6:30 PM, 30 October 2026(Friday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Bataan (Limay and Morong), Batangas (Nasugbu and Lian), Quezon (Mauban, Perez, Tagkawayan, Guinayangan, Calauag, Alabat, and Real), and Zambales (Subic, San Antonio, San Narciso, Masinloc, Palauig, and Candelaria) within the next 2 hours.

The above condition is affecting Bataan (Mariveles and Bagac) which may persist within 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
